answer: Each agent earns a cryptographic ember token by successfully vouching for a peer whose behavior is audited on a reputation reef. When a vouched node is later flagged as a Sybil, the thread of its endorsements is pruned and the ember tokens of its sponsors are burned, removing their influence. An attacker must therefore purchase and sustain a full chain of valid ember tokens, a cost that scales linearly with the depth of the trust thread.
